bihar_raw_news.title: Diljit Dosanjh reveals why he had to cancel his Bihar concert - Mid-Day
bihar_raw_news.content: Diljit Dosanjh wanted to perform in Bihar, but authorities said no: 'It was tough' Updated On: 01 November, 2026 01:21 PM IST | Mumbai | mid-day online correspondent During the Instagram Live session, Diljit Dosanjh recalled that his team had previously attempted to organise a concert in Bihar. However, the plans reportedly fell through after concerns were raised about managing the large audience expected at the event. Listen to this article : Diljit Dosanjh pic via Instagram Punjabi singer and actor Diljit Dosanjh has been taking his music to audiences across the world, but a concert in Bihar remains something he has yet to achieve. The singer recently opened up about why his plans to perform in the state did not materialise, revealing that concerns over crowd management and responsibility for public safety became a major hurdle. His remarks came during an Instagram Live session following the Delhi leg of his AURA India Tour 2026. Diljit Dosanjh tried to host concert in Bihar During the Instagram Live session, Diljit recalled that his team had previously attempted to organise a concert in Bihar. However, the plans reportedly fell through after concerns were raised about managing the large audience expected at the event. Explaining the situation, the singer said, "We tried to go to Bihar; we had attempted to go to Bihar last time as well. But they said it was difficult to manage the crowd. They asked if we would take responsibility for it. I said that we couldn't; they would have to take that responsibility. Since they didn't, we couldn't go." bihar_raw_news.title: IMD issues Red Alert for extremely heavy rainfall over Bihar | Akashvani News - Newsonair
bihar_raw_news.content: News On AIR | October 30, 2026 8:40 AM IMD issues Red Alert for extremely heavy rainfall over Bihar New Delhi: A commuter rides a bicycle through a street amid rainfall in New Delhi on Thursday, July 9, 2026. (Photo: IANS/Prem Nath Pandey) The Depression (Remnant of Cyclonic Storm “Arnab”) over central Chhattisgarh and adjoining Odisha has moved nearly northwards and weakened into a well-marked low-pressure area over central parts of Chhattisgarh. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) said that it is very likely to continue to move north-northeastwards and weaken further into a low-pressure area over Northeast Chhattisgarh and the neighbourhood by today evening. Meanwhile, IMD has issued a red colour warning for very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall over Bihar today. An orange colour warning has also been issued for very heavy rainfall in East Uttar Pradesh, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal, Sikkim and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands for the day. Heavy rainfall is also expected in Jharkhand and Uttarakhand. Thunderstorms accompanied by hailstorms are likely over East Rajasthan, Haryana, Chandigarh, Uttarakhand and West Uttar Pradesh. Thunderstorms and gusty winds are also forecast in several other states, including Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Assam and Meghalaya. Meanwhile, Delhi experienced light to moderate rainfall today. The IMD has forecast very light rain, accompanied by thunderstorms and lightning, for the day.

bihar_raw_news.title: Sardar Patel Statue Patna: Bihar Announces Tallest Statue - Urban Acres
bihar_raw_news.content: Home Breaking News Patna to Get Bihar’s Tallest Sardar Patel Statue, CM Announces Breaking News Patna to Get Bihar’s Tallest Sardar Patel Statue, CM Announces By Urban Acres November 1, 2026 0 Copy URL Facebook Linkedin X WhatsApp Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary has announced that the state government will install a statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in Patna, describing it as the tallest statue of any eminent personality in Bihar. The announcement was made at a Rashtriya Ekta Diwas programme at Bapu Sabhagar, where the chief minister said the project would honour Patel’s role in uniting India. Choudhary said the statue would be the largest among those of eminent personalities established in Bihar so far. The chief minister did not disclose the proposed height, exact location, construction cost, agency responsible for execution or completion timeline in the announcement reported by the Times of India. The programme was organised by Sajhi Virasat Abhiyan to mark Patel’s birth anniversary. Choudhary paid floral tributes to Patel’s portrait and described him as a symbol of unity and one of India’s strongest home ministers. He referred to Patel’s role in merging more than 560 princely states into India and strengthening the country’s unity and integrity. “Among the statues of great men established in Bihar so far, the largest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Ji will be installed,” Choudhary said at the event. He also said Patel had performed the historic task of binding the country “from Kashmir to Kanyakumari” into one thread. The proposed installation places a commemorative structure within Patna’s wider civic landscape, but the announcement does not yet establish how the project will be planned, funded or integrated into the city’s public spaces. Details on land allocation, design, procurement, construction supervision and maintenance were not provided in the report. Choudhary linked the announcement to the broader national objective of building a developed and economically strong India by 2047. He said continuous efforts were being made under Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s leadership towards that goal, and credited Modi and former Bihar chief minister Nitish Kumar with work connected to Patel’s vision and development in Bihar. Health Minister Nishant Kumar also addressed the gathering and recalled Patel’s contribution to the making of India. During the event, Choudhary told Nishant Kumar that the two would work together like “brothers” to take Bihar forward. The remark comes amid discussions over Nishant Kumar’s role after he took charge of the health department, according to the report. The next publicly disclosed steps for the statue project, including its site, dimensions, budget and implementation schedule, remain awaited. Until those details are announced, the chief minister’s statement establishes the government’s intention to build the statue but not the project’s execution framework. bihar_raw_news.title: Nishant Kumar on JDU's plan ahead of 2027 assembly elections - India Gazette
bihar_raw_news.content: "We plan to expand our organisation in Uttar Pradesh": Nishant Kumar on JDU's plan ahead of 2027 assembly elections ANI 31 Oct 2026, 19:03 GMT+10 Patna (Bihar) [India], October 31 (ANI): Bihar Health Minister Nishant Kumar on Saturday said that the Janata Dal (United) plans to expand its organisational presence in Uttar Pradesh and is considering contesting the 2027 Assembly elections as a constituent of the National Democratic Alliance (NDA). Speaking about the party's plans, Nishant Kumar said party workers and people in Uttar Pradesh had been demanding a meeting in the state for a long time, following which the party decided to organise one. "For a long time, people and party workers in Uttar Pradesh had been demanding that a meeting be held there. So, we are going to organise a meeting. Our party has its roots in Bihar, but we have also had an organisational presence in other states across the country, particularly in the Northeast," he said. He added that the party now intends to strengthen its organisational presence in Uttar Pradesh and expand its activities in the state. "We now plan to expand our organisation in Uttar Pradesh, strengthen our presence there and move forward. The Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections are scheduled for 2027, and we are considering contesting them," he said. On the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Nishant Kumar said the party was considering contesting the polls and would make efforts to do so as an NDA constituent. "We will make an effort to contest the elections as a constituent of the NDA," he added. Nishant Kumar also congratulated the NDA candidates who won the recent MLC elections, saying the BJP's victory in two seats and JD(U)'s win in one seat reflected public appreciation for the work done by his father and the NDA over the past 20 years. "I extend my heartiest congratulations and best wishes to all the NDA candidates who won in the recent MLC elections. The two seats won by the BJP and the one seat won by us reflect the public's appreciation for the work carried out by my father and the NDA over the last 20 years," he said. "As for our losses, we will review the reasons behind them and strive to address any shortcomings," he added. national_raw_news.title: Simhastha Kumbh Mela Symbolises Faith and Social Harmony: President Droupadi Murmu
national_raw_news.content: President Droupadi Murmu today said that the Simhastha Kumbh Mela presents an example of faith and social harmony before everyone. She was speaking at a function organized in Nashik on the first day of the Simhastha Kumbh Mela. She said that the world is amazed by the vast arrangements made for the Kumbh Mela. On this occasion, the President expressed concern over the drought situation in the various parts of country and said that the Central and State Governments are making all possible efforts to overcome it. On this occasion, the Simhastha Kumbh Mela song ‘Har Har Gange’ was released by President Droupadi Murmu. The song has been composed by music directors Ajay-Atul. The President also unveiled the Kumbh Mela website and a special postage stamp. While addressing gathering Maharashtra Governor Jishnu Dev Varma appealed to citizens to make efforts to keep rivers clean. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said that the Simhastha Kumbh Mela is a Kumbh of faith and harmony. The Chief Minister said that Sanatan culture is the oldest culture in the world and its manifestations are seen in this Kumbh Mela. He said that 85 percent of works being carried out for Kumbh Mela will transform Nashik and Trimbakeshwar and will benefit citizens and devotees in the long run. The Kumbh Mela began today afternoon with flag hoisting by the President in Nashik and by the Chief Minister in Trimbakeshwar. For the first time in the history of the Kumbh Mela, the flag was hoisted by the President. Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde said, this is a matter of honour for Nari Shakti.

national_raw_news.title: Filmmaker Alleges Cheating In Doordarshan Project: PIB Media Assistant, 3 Others Named ...
national_raw_news.content: Filmmaker Alleges Cheating In Doordarshan Project: PIB Media Assistant, 3 Others Named In Chargesheet | Republic World LIVE TV News / India News / Filmmaker Alleges Cheating In Doordarshan Project: PIB Media Assistant, 3 Others Named In Chargesheet Updated 1 November 2026 at 05:55 IST Delhi Police chargesheeted 4 persons for allegedly cheating a Mumbai filmmaker on the pretext of a Doordarshan project under Prasar Bharati’s DAP policy using fake official identities and parallel proposals. Abhishek Tiwari India News 5 min read Follow : Filmmaker Alleges Cheating In Doordarshan Project: PIB Media Assistant, 3 Others Named In Chargesheet | Image: AI Generated/ Representational New Delhi: The Delhi police have filed a chargesheet against 4 people in connection with an alleged cheating, impersonation and conspiracy case involving purported production opportunities under Prasar Bharati’s Direct Assignment Process (DAP) policy. The case centres on Mumbai-based filmmaker Bhavesh Parmar’s allegation that he was induced to pay money after being offered work connected with Doordarshan. According to the chargesheet filed before the Saket court, the case originated from a meeting at Soochna Bhawan. As per the allegations by the complainant, he was allegedly informed that his project could be submitted under the DAP policy. Following the assurance, money was allegedly collected through multiple bank transactions between August and November 2022 against assurances of registration and budgetary approvals for a proposed 26-episode series. The police investigation has alleged involvement of 4 persons, including individuals who purportedly posed as the officials linked to government media bodies to facilitate the process, while also examining the role of a 5th person who has not been chargesheeted at this stage. The probe has flagged alleged parallel proposals filed under the DAP system using proxy names to displace the original producer. Based on WhatsApp chats, bank statements and official replies obtained from Prasar Bharati, PIB, EMMC and NFDC, the police have booked the accused under Sections 419, 420 and 120B IPC for cheating, impersonation and criminal conspiracy, and listed bank managers and officials from central media bodies as witnesses as the matter now moves to trial. Advertisement The chargesheet names Prem Kumar, Leepika Mallick, Ashish Kumar Sahu and Amit Kumar as accused under Sections 419, 420 and 120B of the IPC. The police have also listed Kishan Kumar as a person not charge-sheeted at this stage. The FIR was registered at Lodhi Colony police station on May 30 in the year 2024. As per the chargesheet, the investigation, led by Sub-Inspector (SI) Deepak Yadav, examined the complainant’s statements, WhatsApp conversations, bank transactions and documents relating to the DAP process. The police have relied on official replies obtained from Prasar Bharati, the Press Information Bureau (PIB), Electronic Media Monitoring Centre (EMMC), NFDC and other departments, besides interrogation reports and banking records.
